description: Memory management routines for qhull, including functions for allocation, freeing, initialization, and statistics of memory buffers used in qhull's internal operations.

methods.name: qh_intcompare
methods.description: Internal comparison function used by qsort and bsearch to compare two integers.

methods.name: qh_memalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size, using freelists for small sizes or malloc for large sizes.

methods.name: qh_memfree
methods.description: Frees memory allocated by qh_memalloc, returning it to freelists or freeing via qh_free.

methods.name: qh_memcheck
methods.description: Checks the consistency of the memory management system.

methods.name: qh_memfreeshort
methods.description: Frees all short and qhull memory buffers.

methods.name: qh_meminit
methods.description: Initializes the memory management system, setting up internal structures and testing pointer sizes.

methods.name: qh_meminitbuffers
methods.description: Initializes memory buffers with specified parameters such as trace level, alignment, number of sizes, buffer size, and initial buffer size.

methods.name: qh_memsetup
methods.description: Sets up memory after running memsize(), including sorting size tables and creating index tables.

methods.name: qh_memsize
methods.description: Defines a free list for a specific size.

methods.name: qh_memstatistics
methods.description: Prints out memory usage statistics and verifies consistency.

methods.name: qh_memtotal
methods.description: Returns total and current bytes of long and short memory allocations, along with maximums.
